form.raceInstanceTitle: Win £1M With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap
form.rpCloseUpComment: dwelt start, in rear throughout, no chance when not clear run inside final furlong (An inquiry was held into the running and riding of Hala Joza, ridden by Darragh Keenan and trained by Martin Dunne, which jumped awkwardly before being restrained from stall 10 to race in rear throughout and staying on fairly in the home straight under considerate handling to finish eighth of eight runners,  beaten 8½ lengths. The rider was interviewed and shown recordings of the race and the Veterinary Officer  examined the filly post-race and had nothing to report. The rider stated that, from his wide draw, his instructions were to get in and sit halfway down the field and to ride his race from there. He stated that his filly was a little slow into stride and whilst he wanted to drop in, there was some interference on his inside so he elected to stay wide and clear of any trouble. He went on to say that this left him three wide and further back than ideal, so he opted to drop in and hope to follow Miss Campanella through but that filly was running green and did not carry him into the race as hoped. He added that once in the straight when he had intended to ask Hala Joza for her full effort and obtain clear running, he was impeded by Blue Force One which had lugged right-handed into his path and resulted in him having to take avoiding action, which he reported at the scales. He went on to say that he had advised connections the filly might improve for a step up in trip and being ridden more prominently. His explanation was noted.)

verdict.comment: Jessica Macey's horses are running well and JENEVER, who has a solid record here, earns the vote ahead of Monks Dream.

comments.arnhem: Useful in Ireland but with modest strike-rate; this 9yo may be best watched on yard debut
comments.flyingfletcher: Two-time C&D winner; close third here on two of his last three starts; each-way claims
comments.grantwood: Four wins last year (including C&D) and reappeared with good second at Wolverhampton
comments.gressington: 6f win at Redcar last September; not ruled out now back down in trip on reappearance
comments.jenever: Has plenty of good course form and he reappears with his trainer among the winners
comments.jungleland: Lightly raced 4yo who has been better than ever this spring & can be bang there once more
comments.lethalnymph: Without a win since 2022 but on a dangerous mark judged on the pick of last season's form
comments.monksdream: Three wins from six course visits; on a career-high mark but still a key player
comments.ormolulu: Prolific on Southwell Tapeta this winter but failed to shine over this C&D in February
comments.secretguest: C&D winner who went close over C&D in December; in the mix if at the top of his game
comments.solaraclaim: Unproven on AW but ended last season in good form on turf; makes reappearance
comments.theturpinator: Course winner who scored on turf last June, but below best on last two runs in September
comments.toughenough: Three-time winner; on a reduced mark but a return to form is needed
comments.williamdewhirst: Has won six times here since November, five over 7f but one over C&D; could be thereabouts

races.raceComment: williamdewhirst is marginally preferred with a score of 54.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more progressive over secretguest. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Excellent course form of 8/26 at newcastle. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having run well at Southwell three weeks ago, six-time course winner POP FAVORITE is taken to return to winning ways now back here.

comments.cubanfiesta: 0-11 but good second over C&D on last month's stable/seasonal debut
comments.goingunderground: Modest strike-rate but has won over C&D and Billy Loughnane is booked for reappearance
comments.impeach: Continues to edge down the weights but he's without a win since November 2023
comments.jumeiravision: Well beaten at Wolverhampton latest but won there two starts ago; chance if on a going day
comments.oddsockshavana: Five-time course winner who went close over C&D three starts ago; could be involved
comments.popfavorite: His last six wins have come here and he was a respectable fourth at Southwell last time
comments.rooska: 0-11 but close second over 7f here recently and can be bang there if seeing out 1m
comments.thatsmyboyluke: Went close over C&D last month; down the field at Southwell since but not written off
comments.yaahobby: Two-time 7f course winner but recent form has been mixed and he's unproven at 1m

races.raceComment: jumeiravision is marginally preferred with a score of 48.8%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over oddsockshavana. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside position advantageous around left-handed bends

verdict.comment: The lightly raced 4yo CORAMENTO made a successful handicap and stable debut here last time and can build on that.

comments.anif: Veteran who can still be competitive; return to handicaps asks for a bit more though
comments.coramento: 1-1 for a yard that's in excellent form; more to give and looks the answer
comments.justtypical: In good form here of late and likely to make another bold bid
comments.millbuie: Unexposed on AW but difficult to know what to expect on this return from a break
comments.rohilla: Has shown very little in seven starts and would be a surprise winner
comments.spartanfighter: Better last time but tries this trip for the first time on his 82nd start
comments.urbandandy: In good form, including here, lately and should be firmly in the mix again
comments.waitandhope: Struggling for a while now and no encouragement in his recent return
comments.wyvern: Good run on his penultimate start and this step back up in trip will suit

races.raceComment: justtypical is marginally preferred with a score of 55.8%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and more progressive over urbandandy. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
